pnpm.//: Force patched transitive deps flagged by `pnpm audit`. Run `pnpm install` to apply, then `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high`.
pnpm.//floors: Each floor is the PATCHED version, not the version that happened to be installed. A caret floor below the fix (fast-uri sat at ^3.1.4 against six highs needing >=3.1.7) is satisfied by the vulnerable release, so the resolver never moves and the override reads as protection while providing none. When raising one of these, write the advisory it closes.
